name: Your Name
summary: Replace this with one sentence about who you are and what you do. Keep it short — the samples below do the real work, not this line.
_instructions: Replace every sample below with a message YOU actually sent. Copy-paste them verbatim: typos, slang, code-switching, punctuation habits, capitalisation, all of it. Do not clean them up — the mess IS the signal.
Aim for 15-20 samples. Fewer than 10 and the voice stays generic.
Cover both registers. Roughly half casual banter, half you explaining something technical. If you only give casual samples the model will be casual when it should be precise, and vice versa.
The 'context' label tells the model when each register applies. Be concrete: 'replying to a friend at 2am' beats 'casual'.
Do not write samples about the topics you want it to discuss. It copies rhythm, not subject matter.
Delete this _instructions key once you have filled the samples in.
